priorityPhilosophy.description: Hierarchy of what matters most when implementing tasks
hierarchy: 2. PHASE 2 FOUNDATION — typed signals and exact identifiers, no heuristics
3. FUNCTIONING CODE — sequential and wave map the same way
4. CORRECTNESS — red-first tests; idempotent, accurate results
5. CODE QUALITY — small local hunks, no dead code left behind
principles: Quality dimensions explicit — qualityDimensions on every implementation task
Edge cases live on the owning implementation task; tests are written and seen failing first

Ship working code with tests; handle Option/Result explicitly; no unwrap() in production

GrokRunner::spawn finds its session directory by diffing ~/.grok/sessions/<encoded cwd>/ before and after the run, and picks the newest by mtime when several appear (runner.rs ~:806-823, ~:952-970, pick_newest_by_mtime ~:471). Assert argv contains `--session-id <uuid>`, RunnerResult.session_id == that uuid, and after dispatch cleanup the other directory and prompt_history.jsonl still exist. Paste the failing output first.
2. Generate Uuid::new_v4() per spawn, push `--session-id <uuid>` before `--prompt-file`, and return Some(uuid), mirroring Claude (runner.rs ~:601-603).
3. Delete the pre/post snapshot, pick_newest_by_mtime, and the dir-diff test (replace it with the new test). Update the WORKAROUND(grok-cli-no-persistence-off) comment.
